summary: Frontend-only regression for v7 iteration (assignment filter, map clustering, reviewer activity trail, and regression on treaty/exports). Logged in via OTP -> token cookie (amankunawat4u@gmail.com). 3 of 4 features work; 1 CRITICAL bug found in Assignment Filter useMemo dependency array causing the dropdown to not re-filter rows when only assignee changes.

ui_bugs.issue: inbox-assignee-filter does NOT filter rows on its own. Setting 'Assigned to me' still showed all 15 rows with only 2 'You' badges (should show 2 rows). Setting 'Unclaimed' still showed 15 rows with only 13 Claim buttons (should show 13 rows). Root cause: useMemo dependency array at Dashboard.jsx:84 is `[subs, q, status, natMin, natMax, dateFrom, dateTo, sortKey, sortDir]` and is MISSING `assignee` and `email`. So changing assignee alone does not recompute the memo. When combined with a status change, the memo re-runs and applies the (already-updated) assignee value via closure, which is why 'Mine + Reviewed' correctly returned 1 row — masking the bug in the combined case only.

action_items: Fix Dashboard.jsx line 84 useMemo deps: add `assignee` and `email` to the dependency array so the Assignment Filter reacts to its own changes. Suggested: `[subs, q, status, assignee, email, natMin, natMax, dateFrom, dateTo, sortKey, sortDir]`.

rca of the issue: Bug: Assignment filter doesn't work standalone. Reproduction: /insights inbox -> select inbox-assignee-filter='Assigned to me' -> observe row count unchanged. Root cause: React useMemo omits `assignee`/`email` from deps at Dashboard.jsx line 84. React reuses the memoized `filtered` array because deps haven't changed, even though the filter callback references the new `assignee` value via closure — but the memo doesn't re-evaluate to pick it up. Mitigation: add `assignee` and `email` to the useMemo dependency array. Verified during test: Mine=15/15 (should be ~2), Unclaimed=15/15 (should be ~13), but Mine+Reviewed=1 works because status change triggers memo recompute which then reads current assignee.
